conflicts.topic: Are the policy limits really confirmed?
conflicts.explanation: The matter record marks limits confirmed, but the coverage note says Metro-North is self-insured with no declarations page and no statement of exposure was ever requested.
The valuation treats $100,000 as the defendant limit, but the coverage note ties that policy to Ferrara personally; Metro-North itself has no stated limit.
